matches.rationale: No finding addresses the simplified LS loss formula in Theorem 3.3. Finding 1 describes an extra log-sum-exp term, a different algebraic error.
Finding 4 identifies the same contradiction in experimental tuning protocols for OLS and Zipf-LS compared to MaxSup, directly matching the asymmetric optimization concern.
Finding 9 points out the discrepancy in Logit Penalty metrics in Table 2, matching the data integrity issue of unusually large within-class distance for that baseline.
No finding addresses the oversimplified causal claim in the Introduction that error amplification alone causes representation collapse.
Finding 6 notes textual inconsistencies in the long-tailed section, but no finding mentions the failure to acknowledge low-shot zero accuracy or its ethical implications.
No finding reports uniformly small or equal standard deviations in Tables 4/5, the core evidence integrity issue.
No finding addresses the gradient derivation omission of the mean logit dependency in Section 3.2.
No finding discusses the overly broad claims in the Conclusion about eliminating error amplification or achieving superior transfer performance.
Finding 7 deals with misattributed references in Appendix H, not the fabricated Heinonen et al. [11] citation in Section 4.1.7.
No finding identifies the contradiction about disabling CutMix/Mixup for DeiT-Small in Section 4.2.1 versus using them in appendices.
No finding addresses the rhetorical overstatement 'more robust alternative' in the Abstract.
